description.en: A button triggers an action on the current page.
A button with an icon only.
An icon button with a short label below it.
A checkbox for selecting one or more options.
An interactive label for filtering or as a removable tag.
A date field with a calendar picker.
An area that files can be dragged and dropped onto.
Groups related form fields under a shared legend.
A file picker for attaching files to a form.
A list of selected files. Each file can be removed.
A radio button for choosing one option of many.
A search field with a search button and optional suggestions.
A dropdown for choosing one option. Supports search and groups.
A switch for turning a setting on or off.
A multi-line text field for longer text.
A single-line text field.
A time field with a time picker.
The site header: logo, main navigation, language switcher, search and login.
A breadcrumb trail that shows the page's place in the site structure.
The site footer: contact details, links and social media.
A navigation link for headers, footers and side navigation. Shows the current page.
Pagination for moving between the pages of a long list.
A skip link that takes keyboard users straight to the main content.
A text link to another page, service or file.
Expandable sections that split long content under headings.
A content card that groups a title, text and actions. The card itself is not a link.
A box-shaped link: the whole box goes to one destination.
A surface with a background, corners and an optional border or shadow.
A table for data in rows and columns.
Tabs for switching between views of content on the same page.
Text styles from headings to body text.
A short label that states an item's status or category.
A loading indicator that shows content is loading.
A dialog that opens on top of the page and needs the user's attention.
